title: MobileLLM-R1: Exploring the Limits of Sub-Billion Language Model Reasoners with Open Training Recipes
authors_zh: Changsheng Zhao, Ernie Chang, Zechun Liu, Chia-Jung Chang, Wei Wen, Chen Lai, Rick Cao, Yuandong Tian, Raghuraman Krishnamoorthi, Yangyang Shi, Vikas Chandra
paper_type_zh: 小模型推理的数据筛选、混合与全栈训练配方
best_for_zh: 研究推理数据配比、影响函数筛选、知识蒸馏、小模型课程与开放配方审计的读者
one_line: MobileLLM-R1 derives phase-specific mixtures with capability probes and influence estimates, then trains 140M-950M models through 4T pretraining, 200B distillation mid-training, and staged SFT without releasing the sampled corpus or full curation pipeline.
MobileLLM-R1 用 capability probe 与 influence estimate 形成分阶段数据配比，并以 4T 预训练、200B 蒸馏式中训练和分阶段 SFT 训练 140M-950M 模型，但未发布抽样语料或完整数据筛选流水线。
why: It exposes concrete source weights, phase budgets, and selection signals for small-model reasoning research while showing why an open recipe and model checkpoints are not equivalent to a frozen, replayable training corpus.
inclusion_reason: A data-centric, full-stack recipe that makes dataset-level source weights and stage budgets unusually explicit and connects hierarchical filtering and influence estimates to sub-billion reasoning-model training.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The official ICLR 2026 paper asks how 140M, 359M, and 949M parameter models can acquire useful mathematical, coding, scientific, and general reasoning behavior under limited capacity and a much smaller token budget than contemporary frontier recipes. Its data question is not merely which public corpora to name, but how to construct capability probes, estimate the marginal contribution of each source, change the mixture as the model learns, and sequence pretraining, knowledge distillation, general instruction tuning, and reasoning SFT.

The Atlas object is a phase-specific construction recipe. A conceptual record is source text or a prompt-response conversation annotated by source, capability domain, filter scores, representative-subset membership, checkpoint influence estimates, mixture weight, and training phase. Most of those process fields are described but not released per record.

This belongs in data_construction_open_release_recipes because it exposes source tables, mixture ratios, phase budgets, checkpoints, and minimal training code. It does not release a frozen combined corpus, a complete curation implementation, or a unified correctness verifier. The bilingual Card is L4_chinese_review_ready and supports recipe inspection and release-gap audit, but not exact data replay. (Paper §§2-4; Appendix A; official repository at commit f518dc7e402876fc694a827385ed25de31242905.)

ICLR 2026 正式论文研究：在容量和 token 预算受限时，如何让 140M、359M 与 949M 参数模型获得可用的数学、代码、科学和通用推理行为。它关注的不只是列出哪些公共语料，而是如何构建 capability probe、估计各来源的边际贡献、随模型学习进程调整数据混合，并安排预训练、知识蒸馏、通用指令微调和推理 SFT 的顺序。

Atlas 中的数据对象是分阶段构建配方。概念上的一条记录是来源文本或 prompt-response 对话，并关联来源、能力域、筛选分数、代表子集成员关系、各 checkpoint 的 influence estimate、混合权重和训练阶段；但这些过程字段大多只在论文中描述，并未逐记录发布。

该工作属于 data_construction_open_release_recipes，因为它公开来源表、混合比例、阶段预算、checkpoint 和最小训练代码。它没有发布冻结的组合语料、完整数据筛选实现或统一正确性 verifier。双语 Card 已达到 L4_chinese_review_ready，可用于配方检查与发布缺口审计，但不能视为可精确重放的数据发布。（论文 §§2-4、附录 A；官方仓库 commit f518dc7e402876fc694a827385ed25de31242905。）

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The central contribution is a model-aware data schedule rather than a new standalone corpus. For pretraining, each candidate source is reduced to a representative subset: a FineWeb-Edu classifier keeps educational-quality scores above 4, Ask-LLM ranks reasoning relevance and retains the top 10%, a domain-specific Ask-LLM pass refines code/math/knowledge assignment, and semantic deduplication reduces each source subset to roughly 10,000 examples. Combined subsets form capability-probing distributions for Code, Math, and Knowledge.

The recipe then extends AutoMixer. Separate domain models and ten checkpoints provide self- and cross-capability influence estimates; later checkpoints receive larger weights, and aggregated influence determines dataset-level sampling ratios. Mid-training makes the feedback model-dependent: it retains samples with estimated influence above zero, recomputes dataset weights, trains the model, and repeats for two phases.

The feedback contract is mixed and heuristic. FineWeb-Edu predicts educational quality; Ask-LLM judges perceived reasoning relevance; probe NLL and AutoMixer approximate transfer to selected capabilities. These signals can rank and filter records, but they do not verify factual truth, intermediate reasoning, or final-answer correctness. Compared with uniform mixing, ordinary Dolmino mid-training, or post-training-only distillation, the distinctive direction is to connect capability probes and evolving model state to source weights across the full training stack. (Paper §§2-3; Figures 3-6.)

核心贡献不是一个新的独立语料库，而是一套随模型状态变化的数据日程。预训练阶段先把每个候选来源压缩为代表子集：FineWeb-Edu classifier 保留 educational-quality score 大于 4 的样本；Ask-LLM 按推理相关性排序并保留前 10%；面向 code、math、knowledge 的专用 Ask-LLM 判断进一步细分能力域；semantic deduplication 再把每个来源子集缩减到约 10,000 条。合并后的子集形成 Code、Math、Knowledge 三类 capability-probing distribution。

随后配方扩展 AutoMixer：三个能力域的独立模型与十个 checkpoint 提供 self-influence 和 cross-capability influence estimate，后期 checkpoint 权重更高，聚合后的 influence 决定数据集级采样比例。中训练阶段让反馈随模型共同演化：保留 estimated influence 大于零的样本，重新计算数据集权重，训练模型，再进入下一阶段；论文实际采用两个阶段。

该 feedback contract 是混合且启发式的。FineWeb-Edu 预测教育价值，Ask-LLM 判断感知到的推理相关性，probe NLL 与 AutoMixer 近似衡量对指定能力的迁移贡献。这些信号可以排序和筛选记录，却不能验证事实真伪、中间推理或最终答案正确性。相较于 uniform mixing、普通 Dolmino 中训练或只做后训练蒸馏，方向上的关键差别是把 capability probe 与演化中的模型状态连接到全训练栈的数据来源权重。（论文 §§2-3，Figures 3-6。）

title: Method
方法
html:
The reconstructable pipeline is:

  1. Source and probe construction. Start from the public corpora listed in Appendix Table 5. For each source, apply FineWeb-Edu score >4, generic and domain-specific Ask-LLM top-10% selection, and cross-corpus semantic deduplication. Approximately 10,000 examples per source form representative subsets, which are combined into Code, Math, and Knowledge capability probes. The Ask-LLM model, exact prompts, deduplication model, and threshold are not disclosed.
  2. Pretraining selection and mixing. Train leave-one-source-out models to measure source effects on probe NLL. Extend AutoMixer by estimating each representative sample's influence on all three capability probes at ten checkpoints; linearly increasing checkpoint weights favor later training. Aggregate token-weighted influence to dataset weights. Sample two 2T-token phases from the listed 1.8T-token pool, shifting phase 2 toward OpenWebMath, FineMath, Algebraic Stack, Facebook Natural Reasoning, and other specialized sources.
  3. Model-data co-evolution in mid-training. Mix Dolmino subsets, Nemotron code/math, StarCoder, and eight named benchmark training splits. At each phase, retain records whose estimated influence is positive, aggregate influence into new dataset ratios, train, and repeat. Two 100B-token phases are reported. Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct supplies logits, and the student minimizes KL divergence in addition to the training objective.
  4. Post-training. Run two epochs over 866K Tulu-3-sft-olmo-2-mixture-0225 examples, then four epochs over a reported 6.2M-example mixture: OpenMathReasoning 3.2M, OpenScienceReasoning-2 802K, and OpenCodeReasoning-2 2.2M. The reasoning stage uses 32k sequences and full prompt-response supervision.
  5. Evaluation and artifacts. Evaluate base and final checkpoints on math, code, commonsense, and knowledge benchmarks. The pinned repository provides minimal pretraining, SFT, and math-evaluation code and the Hugging Face collection provides base/final weights. Exact reconstruction additionally requires immutable upstream revisions, selected IDs, sharding, seeds, probe rows, influence logs, curation code, and a paper-matching configuration; these are unavailable.

This pipeline does not use one global reward or terminal predicate. Positive influence is the mid-training retention rule; KL divergence and token-level SFT loss are training objectives; benchmark metrics are evaluation outputs, not evidence that each selected record is correct. (Paper §§2-4; Appendix A; repository pretrain/, sft/, and evaluation/.)

可重建的流水线如下：

  1. 来源与 probe 构建。 从附录 Table 5 列出的公共语料出发，对每个来源依次应用 FineWeb-Edu score >4、通用与领域专用 Ask-LLM 前 10% 筛选，以及跨语料 semantic deduplication。每个来源约 10,000 条样本形成 representative subset，再组合成 Code、Math、Knowledge capability probe。Ask-LLM 模型、完整 prompts、去重模型和阈值均未披露。
  2. 预训练筛选与混合。 训练 leave-one-source-out 模型，以 probe NLL 衡量来源影响。方法扩展 AutoMixer，在十个 checkpoint 上估计每条代表样本对三个 capability probe 的 influence；checkpoint 权重线性增加，使后期训练占更高权重。按 token 加权聚合 influence 得到数据集权重。从列出的 1.8T-token 来源池中为两个阶段各采样 2T token，第二阶段提高 OpenWebMath、FineMath、Algebraic Stack、Facebook Natural Reasoning 等专门来源的权重。
  3. 中训练中的 model-data co-evolution。 混合 Dolmino 子集、Nemotron code/math、StarCoder 和八个具名 benchmark 训练集。每个阶段保留 estimated influence 为正的记录，把 influence 聚合为新数据集比例，训练模型后再迭代。论文报告两个各 100B-token 的阶段。Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 提供 logits，学生模型除训练目标外还最小化 KL divergence。
  4. 后训练。 先在 866K 条 Tulu-3-sft-olmo-2-mixture-0225 上训练两个 epoch，再在报告为 6.2M 条的混合上训练四个 epoch：OpenMathReasoning 3.2M、OpenScienceReasoning-2 802K、OpenCodeReasoning-2 2.2M。推理阶段使用 32k 序列和完整 prompt-response 监督。
  5. 评测与 artifact。 在数学、代码、常识与知识 benchmark 上评测 base/final checkpoint。固定提交的仓库提供最小预训练、SFT 与数学评测代码，Hugging Face collection 提供 base/final 权重。精确重建还需要固定的上游版本、入选 ID、分片、随机种子、probe 记录、influence 日志、筛选代码和与论文一致的配置；这些均未提供。

该流水线没有单一全局 reward 或 terminal predicate。positive influence 是中训练的保留规则；KL divergence 与 token-level SFT loss 是训练目标；benchmark 指标是评测输出，不能证明每条入选记录正确。（论文 §§2-4、附录 A；仓库 pretrain/、sft/、evaluation/。）

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The evidence is strongest for the recipe's model outcomes and component ablations, not for the quality of every selected record.

  • Mixture and filtering signals. Figure 4 shows the influence-derived pretraining mixture lowering perplexity curves against uniform sampling on the paper's code, math, and knowledge evaluation aggregates. Figure 6 shows positive-influence mid-training subsampling maintaining higher MMLU than the original mixture, with and without the 8B teacher. These are author-reported curves; the released repository lacks the curation implementation needed for independent replay.
  • Post-training order. In Table 1, staged Tulu-3 then math/science/code reasoning SFT reports 57.8 MATH, 68.5 GSM8K, 13.7 LCBv6, and 44.0 MMLU. Joint training reports 56.2, 53.1, 14.9, and 44.0 respectively. Staging helps the reported math scores but does not dominate LCBv6.
  • Controlled final-SFT comparison. With one epoch of the same joint reasoning SFT, the 949M checkpoint reports 57.8 MATH, 68.5 GSM8K, and 13.7 LCBv6. OLMo-2-0425-1B-SFT reports 53.0/58.8/11.4, and SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct reports 41.4/50.5/7.4 (Table 2). This comparison supports a contribution from earlier training, while architecture and optimizer differences remain possible confounders.
  • Final checkpoint. Under Table 9's zero-shot protocol, MobileLLM-R1-950M reports 74.0 MATH500, 67.5 GSM8K, 15.5 AIME'24, 16.3 AIME'25, and 19.9 LCBv6. Qwen3-0.6B reports 73.0, 79.2, 11.3, 17.0, and 14.9. Results are mixed by task rather than uniformly better.
  • Cost. Appendix D.3 reports about 6,800 GPU-hours for representative-set construction, influence computation, and leave-one-out ablation, plus about 38,600 GPU-hours for model training. This makes the selection process substantial even though the final models are sub-billion scale.

Benchmark performance is evidence about the trained checkpoints under the reported setup; it is not proof that the mixture is uncontaminated, uniformly licensed, or optimally filtered. No independent reproduction is claimed here.

证据最能支持的是配方的模型结果与组件消融，而不是每条入选记录的质量。

  • 混合与筛选信号。 Figure 4 显示，在论文构造的 code、math、knowledge 评测聚合上，influence-derived 预训练配比的 perplexity 曲线低于 uniform sampling。Figure 6 显示，不论是否使用 8B teacher，positive-influence 中训练子采样的 MMLU 曲线都高于原始混合。这些是作者报告的曲线；官方仓库没有发布可供独立重放的数据筛选实现。
  • 后训练顺序。 Table 1 中，先 Tulu-3、后 math/science/code reasoning SFT 的分阶段方案报告 MATH 57.8、GSM8K 68.5、LCBv6 13.7、MMLU 44.0；联合训练分别为 56.2、53.1、14.9、44.0。分阶段训练改善了报告中的数学成绩，但没有在 LCBv6 上全面占优。
  • 受控 final-SFT 对比。 在相同联合推理 SFT 上训练一个 epoch 后，949M checkpoint 报告 MATH 57.8、GSM8K 68.5、LCBv6 13.7；OLMo-2-0425-1B-SFT 为 53.0/58.8/11.4，SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct 为 41.4/50.5/7.4（Table 2）。该对比支持更早训练阶段有贡献，但架构与优化器差异仍可能是混杂因素。
  • 最终 checkpoint。 按 Table 9 的 zero-shot protocol，MobileLLM-R1-950M 报告 MATH500 74.0、GSM8K 67.5、AIME'24 15.5、AIME'25 16.3、LCBv6 19.9；Qwen3-0.6B 分别为 73.0、79.2、11.3、17.0、14.9。结果随任务而异，并非全面更高。
  • 成本。 附录 D.3 报告 representative-set 构建、influence 计算和 leave-one-out 消融约耗费 6,800 GPU-hours，模型训练另耗费约 38,600 GPU-hours。即使最终模型不足十亿参数，数据选择流程仍有显著计算成本。

Benchmark 表现只能说明训练后 checkpoint 在报告设置下的结果，不能证明数据混合无污染、许可统一或筛选最优。本 Card 不声称这些结果已被独立复现。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The closest ingredients are established rather than wholly new: FineWeb-Edu supplies an educational-quality classifier, Ask-LLM supplies model-based selection, AutoMixer supplies scalable influence approximation, Dolmino supplies a mid-training base, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct supplies logit distillation, and Tulu-3/OpenMathReasoning/OpenScienceReasoning-2/OpenCodeReasoning-2 supply post-training data.

The concrete change is how these pieces are connected for small models. Representative subsets become capability probes rather than benchmark labels; self- and cross-capability influence is integrated across ten checkpoints to set source weights; positive-influence filtering is recomputed as the model changes; and the resulting phases are carried through from random initialization to long-context reasoning SFT. The paper also reports the source weights and token budgets phase by phase, making the construction hypothesis auditable at recipe level.

What is not new is the upstream corpora, SFT itself, KL distillation, or a correctness verifier. Nor does the work establish a new reusable dataset: the combined records, sampled IDs, rejected examples, and sample-level scores are absent. The direction signal for reasoning-data research is model-aware mixture design under tight capacity, but reuse requires checking whether the unpublished probe and influence choices drive the reported effect and whether the method transfers beyond these three capability domains and model sizes.

最接近的组件多数已有来源：FineWeb-Edu 提供 educational-quality classifier，Ask-LLM 提供模型式筛选，AutoMixer 提供可扩展的 influence approximation，Dolmino 是中训练基础，Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 提供 logit distillation，Tulu-3、OpenMathReasoning、OpenScienceReasoning-2 与 OpenCodeReasoning-2 提供后训练数据。

具体变化在于这些组件如何服务于小模型。代表子集被用作 capability probe，而不是直接使用 benchmark 标签；方法在十个 checkpoint 上整合 self-influence 与 cross-capability influence 以设置来源权重；随着模型状态改变重新执行 positive-influence filtering；所得阶段从随机初始化一直贯穿到长上下文 reasoning SFT。论文还逐阶段报告来源权重与 token 预算，使构建假设在配方层可审计。

并非新内容的部分包括上游语料、SFT、KL distillation 和正确性 verifier；该工作也没有形成新的可复用数据集，因为组合记录、抽样 ID、被拒样本和 sample-level score 均未发布。对 reasoning-data 研究而言，方向信号是容量严格受限时的 model-aware mixture design；但复用前仍需验证未公开的 probe/influence 选择是否决定了报告效果，以及方法能否迁移到三个能力域和这些模型规模之外。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Method and feedback limits. FineWeb-Edu and Ask-LLM scores are proxies for educational value and reasoning relevance. They can admit persuasive but incorrect text and reject rare, terse, or domain-specific examples. The positive-influence threshold is conditional on the chosen probes, checkpoint, and approximation; a record with delayed or out-of-domain benefit may be removed. The Ask-LLM model and prompts, semantic-deduplication model and threshold, and sample-level influence distribution are undisclosed.

Data and release limits. Appendix Table 5 lists 1.8T source tokens, the paper rounds this to approximately 2T, and resampling consumes 2T in each pretraining phase; adding two 100B mid-training phases yields 4.2T exposure before SFT, not 4.2T unique tokens. No combined corpus, sampled IDs, random seeds, shards, probe rows, rejected examples, influence logs, or exact upstream revisions are released. Phase-2 mid-training includes eight benchmark training splits, but no end-to-end decontamination or overlap report is provided. FAIR Noncommercial terms cover the Meta research materials, not the heterogeneous licenses of all upstream datasets.

Reproducibility and experimental limits. At pinned commit f518dc7e402876fc694a827385ed25de31242905, the repository provides minimal training and evaluation code but no hierarchical filtering, leave-one-out, AutoMixer, or subsampling implementation. Its example pretraining script uses 480k steps, cosine scheduling, learning rate 5e-4, and 1k warmup, whereas Appendix Table 4 reports 500k steps, linear decay, learning rate 4e-3, and 2k warmup. The repository has no tagged release. Reported benchmark improvements are not an independent causal validation of the selected data, and some comparisons retain architecture and optimization confounders. These release findings are curator audits based on the official repository, not limitations explicitly acknowledged by the authors.

方法与反馈限制。 FineWeb-Edu 与 Ask-LLM 分数只是教育价值和推理相关性的 proxy，可能接收表达可信但内容错误的文本，也可能拒绝稀有、简短或高度领域化的样本。positive-influence threshold 依赖所选 probe、checkpoint 与近似方法；具有延迟收益或域外收益的记录可能被删除。Ask-LLM 模型与 prompts、semantic-deduplication 模型与阈值、sample-level influence 分布均未披露。

数据与发布限制。 附录 Table 5 列出 1.8T source tokens，论文将其约写为 2T；重采样使两个预训练阶段各消耗 2T，再加两个 100B 中训练阶段，SFT 前累计 exposure 为 4.2T，而不是 4.2T 唯一 token。组合语料、抽样 ID、随机种子、分片、probe 记录、被拒样本、influence 日志和准确上游 revision 均未发布。第二中训练阶段包含八个 benchmark 训练集，但没有端到端 decontamination 或 overlap 报告。FAIR Noncommercial 条款覆盖 Meta 发布的 research materials，不能替代所有上游数据集的异构许可。

复现与实验限制。 在固定 commit f518dc7e402876fc694a827385ed25de31242905 中，仓库提供最小训练和评测代码，却没有 hierarchical filtering、leave-one-out、AutoMixer 或 subsampling 实现。示例预训练脚本使用 480k steps、cosine scheduling、学习率 5e-4 和 1k warmup，而附录 Table 4 报告 500k steps、linear decay、学习率 4e-3 和 2k warmup。仓库也没有 tagged release。Benchmark 提升不是对入选数据的独立因果验证，部分比较仍存在架构与优化器混杂。这些发布缺口是 Card 作者根据官方仓库做出的审计结论，不是论文作者明确列出的限制。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the Data Construction and Open Release Recipes track, this paper is useful as a blueprint for experiments that separate four decisions: representative-probe construction, dataset-level mixture weights, model-dependent sample rejection, and stage ordering. A lab can hold architecture and compute fixed, replace one signal at a time, and test whether uniform, heuristic, loss-based, or influence-based selection produces different capability and forgetting profiles.

The phase tables are also an audit template. Reusers should record the original source size separately from consumed-token exposure; snapshot every upstream revision; retain accepted and rejected IDs; version the classifier, Ask-LLM prompts, deduplication configuration, probe rows, and checkpoint scores; isolate benchmark training splits; and produce a per-source license matrix. The mismatch between the paper configuration and example script should be resolved before a reproduction claim.

Reuse class: suitable for recipe-level construction studies and audit reference, with official base/final checkpoints available for evaluation. Exact corpus replay, redistributed training reuse, and claims of reproducing the paper's curation are blocked until immutable manifests, full filtering/influence code, source versions, decontamination evidence, and license compatibility are supplied.

对 Data Construction and Open Release Recipes 方向，这篇论文可作为拆分四类决策的实验蓝图：representative-probe 构建、数据集级混合权重、随模型变化的样本拒绝，以及阶段顺序。研究者可以固定架构与算力，每次替换一种信号，比较 uniform、heuristic、loss-based 和 influence-based 选择是否导致不同的能力与遗忘曲线。

分阶段表格也可直接转化为审计模板。复用者应把原始来源规模与 consumed-token exposure 分开记录；固定所有上游 revision；保留接收和拒绝 ID；版本化 classifier、Ask-LLM prompts、去重配置、probe 记录与 checkpoint 分数；隔离 benchmark 训练集；并建立逐来源许可矩阵。在声称复现前，还必须解释论文配置与示例脚本之间的差异。

复用等级：适合作为配方级数据构建研究与审计参考，官方 base/final checkpoint 可用于评测。若缺少不可变 manifest、完整 filtering/influence 代码、来源版本、decontamination 证据和许可兼容性，就不能精确重放语料、再分发训练数据或声称复现论文的数据筛选流程。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read §§2-3 before the benchmark tables: the key object is the capability-probe and influence-driven mixture, not merely the 950M checkpoint.
  • Keep the 1.8T listed pool, approximately 2T rounded source claim, 4T pretraining exposure, and 4.2T pre-SFT exposure separate.
  • Positive estimated influence is a selection proxy, not a correctness verifier; the exact Ask-LLM and deduplication settings remain unknown.
  • Table 1 contains a trade-off: staged SFT improves reported MATH/GSM8K but trails joint training on LCBv6.
  • Audit Appendix Tables 4-7 against the pinned repository before reuse; the sampled corpus and core curation pipeline are not released, and the example pretraining script does not match Table 4.

• 应先读 §§2-3，再看 benchmark 表：核心对象是 capability probe 与 influence-driven mixture，而不只是 950M checkpoint。
  • 必须区分列出的 1.8T 来源池、约写为 2T 的来源规模、4T 预训练 exposure，以及 SFT 前 4.2T exposure。
  • positive estimated influence 是选择 proxy，不是正确性 verifier；准确的 Ask-LLM 与去重设置仍为未知。
  • Table 1 存在权衡：分阶段 SFT 提高了报告中的 MATH/GSM8K，但 LCBv6 低于联合训练。
  • 复用前应把附录 Tables 4-7 与固定提交的仓库逐项核对；抽样语料和核心筛选流水线未发布，示例预训练脚本也与 Table 4 不一致。

value.html: Public web, educational, code, mathematics, science, academic, instruction, and benchmark-training corpora listed in Appendix Tables 5-7.
Pretraining and mid-training text records plus general-instruction and long-form math, science, and code conversations for SFT.
Upstream corpus authors and generators supply text and reasoning conversations; Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct supplies logits for mid-training distillation.

Offline representative-set construction, capability-probe evaluation, leave-one-out training, AutoMixer-style influence estimation, two-phase pretraining, two-phase distillation mid-training, general SFT, and reasoning SFT.

FineWeb-Edu educational-quality classification, Ask-LLM relevance judgments, capability-probe NLL, and estimated sample influence guide selection; KL divergence and token-level SFT losses train models. No unified answer-correctness verifier is disclosed.

Mid-training retains a sample when its estimated influence is greater than zero; pretraining assigns dataset-level weights from aggregated influence. No unified terminal predicate covers upstream SFT conversations.
Randomly initialized MobileLLM-R1 models with 140.2M, 359.4M, and 949.2M parameters.
Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct for mid-training logit distillation; the model used for Ask-LLM and the generators of all upstream SFT traces are not fully disclosed here.
Existing corpora are filtered and resampled rather than generated by one model; upstream post-training datasets contain externally generated reasoning traces.

Two pretraining phases sample 2T tokens each from a listed 1.8T-token source pool; two mid-training phases sample 100B tokens each; general SFT uses 866K examples for two epochs and reasoning SFT uses a reported 6.2M examples for four epochs.

Build representative subsets with FineWeb-Edu score above 4, generic and domain-specific Ask-LLM top-10% selection, and semantic deduplication; derive pretraining weights from influence; retain mid-training samples with positive estimated influence.
Ask-LLM and upstream trace-generation budgets are undisclosed; training sequence lengths are 2k for pretraining, 4k for mid-training/general SFT, and 32k for reasoning SFT.
Pretraining and SFT use Adam; mid-training also minimizes KL divergence to Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. Influence is aggregated across ten checkpoints, with later checkpoints weighted more heavily.

Appendix Table 5 lists a 1.8T-token pretraining pool, described approximately as 2T, and phase-specific weights. Mid-training adds Dolmino, Nemotron, StarCoder, and named benchmark training splits; post-training uses Tulu-3 and three open reasoning datasets.
Phase-2 mid-training includes training splits of TriviaQA, OBQA, NaturalQuestions, PIQA, GSM8K, BoolQ, ARC-Easy, and ARC-Challenge. Sampled manifests and an end-to-end split ledger are not released.

items: The listed 1.8T-token source pool, approximately 2T source claim, 4T pretraining exposure, and 4.2T pre-SFT exposure are different quantities.
FineWeb-Edu and Ask-LLM scores measure educational quality and perceived reasoning relevance, not factual or solution correctness.
Influence estimates depend on the probe distribution, model checkpoint, approximation, and undisclosed prompt and deduplication choices.
Negative-influence filtering can discard rare or delayed-benefit examples.
Benchmark training splits enter phase-2 mid-training, while no decontamination or overlap report is released.
The official repository lacks the capability-probe, Ask-LLM, semantic-deduplication, influence, and subsampling pipeline.
The example pretraining shell configuration differs from the paper's Table 4 settings.
No immutable combined corpus, sampled IDs, or tagged code release is available.
FAIR Noncommercial terms do not replace heterogeneous upstream dataset licenses.
Benchmark improvements do not by themselves establish data quality or causal attribution to one filtering component.
